text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, a while after successfully 
completing her first three years in the 
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...I really feel blessed with great people 
and good fortune.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Dantsu Flame muttered under her breath.
choice_data_list: What's wrong, all of a sudden?
What's wrong, all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. I mean, to begin with, the other 
three from our class are amazing, aren't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Tachyon-chan, a natural-born genius.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Pokke-chan, you have everything I don't.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Cafe-chan, a bundle of sheer potential 
that makes you feel a brilliant future 
ahead.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“Still, when I finish a race, I always 
realize... I've received so much from 
everyone along the way.”

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I feel like that unwillingness to give up 
grew stronger with every race against 
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
And also, everyone from when I was 
recuperating in Hokkaido, and the doctors 
who took care of me!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was so kind and warm, and my legs 
healed so many times faster than expected 
absolutely thanks to all of you—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Because of the fan I met there, I was able 
to realize something truly important.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm so glad I got to meet all our 
fans, too.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
When I started Umastagram, I only thought 
of it as a way to get people to know who I 
was, but...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Just interacting through social media is 
heartwarming enough, and meeting them in 
person gives me so much energy.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Hearing someone say "do your best" really 
gives you strength, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I think it's thanks to everyone that I 
was able to become special."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...... Above all, the most important thing 
is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After Dants Flame murmured that, our eyes 
met.
choice_data_list: I'm really glad I met you too.
I'm glad I got to meet you too

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...I haven't said anything yet!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I let out a laugh despite myself, but 
managed to keep talking anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She isn't necessarily stronger at heart 
than others. However, she simply refused 
to ever let go of her dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even when beaten down by reality, lost and 
on the run, in the end, she never allowed 
herself to give up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
He remarked that those three years felt 
like having such "indomitable" strength 
vividly displayed right before his eyes.
choice_data_list: Thank you for coming into my life.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Geez. You can be really unfair 
sometimes, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Still, thank *you* as well.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“For seeing me as special before anyone 
else did.”

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...You've come to know everything about 
me, understand me, and support me."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, they came closer and shared 
their strength with me."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad I met you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—Afterward, we talked about all sorts of 
things over a delicious meal."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of my debut. The daily training. 
My dazzling contemporaries who were so 
brilliant it almost stung. The many grand 
stages I raced across.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The daily path that Dantsu Flame has run 
in her own unique way...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I'm full. That was delicious.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"We got to talk about so much, and— 
......"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dants Frame suddenly stops in her tracks. 
She is looking up at... a round full moon.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Um, may I ask one last thing? I have an 
ambition.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're at it, I kinda want to become 
an Umamusume who goes down in history 
books!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, is that asking a bit too much after 
all?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“Still, if you give up from the start, you 
can't accomplish anything... right?”

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Right. ...Alright, from now on, I'll do 
everything I can to become the main star 
of the Umamusume world!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep giving it our all from here on 
out, too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame did not leave the grand 
stage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chasing that dream with unyielding 
devotion—that flame will surely ignite 
someone else's heart one day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Riding along the unbroken thread of fate, 
perhaps it might even reach... far, far 
into the future.
